configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as it appears in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Server Message
configurationFields.description: Sets the text displayed in the server's info box

configurationFields.label: Make Server Public
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will show on the server browser

configurationFields.label: Server Language
configurationFields.description: Sets the server language

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of players allowed to join the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Level Difficulty
configurationFields.description: Sets the level difficulty. 0 = easiest, 100 = hellish

configurationFields.label: Allowed Mission Types
configurationFields.description: Sets a comma-separated list of mission types for the server. If multiple are selected the server randomly chooses one (PvP Game Mode can only run Combat). Select from Salvage, Monster, Cargo, Beacon, Nest, Mineral, Combat, AbandonedOutpost, Escort, Pirate, ScanAlienRuins, ClearAlienRuins, All

configurationFields.label: Selected Submarine
configurationFields.description: Sets the submarine that will be used in a round. If empty, the server alphabetically picks the first submarine

configurationFields.label: Submarine Selection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets how the next submarine should be chosen. Manual = only a client with the SelectSub permission can select. Random = submarine is randomly picked. Vote = all players can vote

configurationFields.label: Hidden Submarines
configurationFields.description: Sets a comma-separated list of submarines to be hidden from selection/purchase

configurationFields.label: Selected Shuttle
configurationFields.description: Sets the respawn shuttle that will be used in a round. If empty, the server alphabetically picks the first shuttle

configurationFields.label: Default Game Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the default game mode, which will apply unless changed via the method set under "Game Mode Selection Method"

configurationFields.label: Game Mode Selection Method
configurationFields.description: Sets how the game mode can be changed. Manual = only a client with the SelectMode permission can select. Random = game mode is randomised. Vote = all players can vote

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be able to use voice chat

configurationFields.label: Start When Players Ready
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will automatically start a round if enough players are ready, based on the "Minimum Player Ready Ratio". Otherwise, the round must be manually started

configurationFields.label: Minimum Player Ready Ratio
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum ratio of players required to be ready for a round to be automatically started, if "Start When Ready" is set

configurationFields.label: Allow Spectating
configurationFields.description: If enabled, dead players can spectate. Otherwise, they are sent into the lobby

configurationFields.label: AFK Kick Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time a player must be AFK to be auto-kicked

configurationFields.label: Kill Disconnection Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time a player must be disconnected from their body for the character to be killed

configurationFields.label: Randomize Seed Between Rounds
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will generate a new seed each round

configurationFields.label: Mod Loading
configurationFields.description: Download mods by workshop item ID under the Updates menu. Load them by editing config_player.xml in accordance with [these instructions]()

configurationFields.label: Share Files With Players
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will send missing files to clients (currently only .sub files). Otherwise, if a client is missing required files they cannot spawn and will be sent back into the lobby

configurationFields.label: Allow Mod Downloads
configurationFields.description: If enabled, clients will be able to download required mods from the server. Otherwise they will need to obtain the mods themselves

configurationFields.label: Voting Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the timeout that applies to voting

configurationFields.label: Allowed Client Name Characters
configurationFields.description: Sets the characters approved for use in a client name. Enter as UTF-16 character code ranges. More information can be found [here](https://barotraumagame.com/wiki/Serversettings.xml)

configurationFields.label: Save Server Logs
configurationFields.description: If enabled, server logs will be saved in the ServerLogs folder upon server shutdown

configurationFields.label: Log File Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of lines generated in a log file before it is rotated

configurationFields.label: Server Tickrate
configurationFields.description: Sets the tickrate of the server

configurationFields.label: Enable UPnP
configurationFields.description: If set, UPnP will be enabled on the server. Requires a UPnP-enabled router to function

configurationFields.label: Play Style
configurationFields.description: Sets the server play style displayed in the server browser and lobby

configurationFields.label: Allow Round End Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can vote to end the round

configurationFields.label: Minimum Round End Vote Ratio
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum proportion of round end votes required to end a round (if Round End Vote is enabled)

configurationFields.label: Allow Respawning
configurationFields.description: If enabled, respawning of dead players will be allowed. Otherwise, dead players will have to spectate until the round ends

configurationFields.label: Respawn Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between each respawn wave

configurationFields.label: Minimum Respawn Ratio
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum proportion of dead/spectating players required for the respawn timer to start

configurationFields.label: Skill Loss On Death
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of a player's skill level that is lost on death

configurationFields.label: Enable Respawn Shuttle
configurationFields.description: If enabled, respawning players may spawn in a shuttle away from the main submarine and must dock or otherwise merge with the crew. Otherwise, players are spawned in the submarine on certain job spawnpoints, depending on their job

configurationFields.label: Maximum Respawn Transport Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum time the respawn shuttle has to dock to the submarine. If time runs out before the shuttle docks it will automatically return to the first outpost

configurationFields.label: Line Of Sight Effect Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the line of sight (LOS) effect mode

configurationFields.label: Show Enemy Health Bars
configurationFields.description: Sets whether enemies' health status is shown, via health bars above their heads

configurationFields.label: Traitor Probability
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage probability that a traitor will be on board

configurationFields.label: Traitor Danger Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the severity of damage a traitor’s work is likely to cause during a round

configurationFields.label: Traitor Minimum Player Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of players required for a traitor to be picked

configurationFields.label: Traitor Accusation Minimum Player Percentage
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum required percentage of players who must vote in favour to successfully accuse a traitor

configurationFields.label: Maximum Money Transfer Request
configurationFields.description: Sets how much money players are allowed to request from the bank. 0 = money requests disabled

configurationFields.label: Looted Money Destination
configurationFields.description: Sets where looted money should be sent

configurationFields.label: Allow Ragdoll Button
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can ragdoll on their own if they hold the button down. Otherwise, players must be stunned (or be dead) to ragdoll

configurationFields.label: Bot Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of bots that should be spawned in a round. This is limited by the "Maximum Bot Count"

configurationFields.label: Maximum Bot Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of allowed bots in a round

configurationFields.label: Bot Spawn Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets how bots should be spawned. Normal = bots fill the amount of slots set in "Bot Count". Fill = bots skip that value and fully fill empty player slots

configurationFields.label: Disable Bot Conversations
configurationFields.description: If set, bot conversations will not be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If enabled, friendly fire between players will be allowed (they can deal damage to each other)

configurationFields.label: Enable Killable Outpost NPCs
configurationFields.description: If enabled, outpost NPCs will be able to be killed

configurationFields.label: Enable Destructible Outposts
configurationFields.description: If enabled, outposts will be destructible (able to take damage)

configurationFields.label: Lock All Default Wires
configurationFields.description: If set, the ability to disconnect or change any default wires in a submarine will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Rewiring
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can rewire anything except if it has been set otherwise in the submarine

configurationFields.label: Allow WiFi Linking To Chat
configurationFields.description: If enabled, WiFi components on the submarine can be linked to chat

configurationFields.label: Allow Disguises
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can disguise themselves by using another player's ID card. Otherwise, players will always have their names above them even when covering their face

configurationFields.label: Allow Vote Kicking
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can vote to kick others players

configurationFields.label: Minimum Ratio For Vote Kicking
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum proportion of votes required to vote-kick a player (if Vote Kicking is enabled)

configurationFields.label: Vote Kicking Disabled Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum time period that must pass before a player can be vote-kicked after joining

configurationFields.label: Vote Kicking Ban Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the ban duration for players who are vote-kicked

configurationFields.label: Maximum Ban Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum ban time that can be set in the lobby host UI

configurationFields.label: Enable Ban After Incorrect Password
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be auto-banned after exceeding the maximum password retries set under "Maximum Password Retries"

configurationFields.label: Maximum Password Retries Before Ban
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of failed password attempts before a player is auto-banned. Requires "Enable Failed Password Ban" to be set

configurationFields.label: Enable DOS Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will automatically kick players who are causing the server to perform poorly

configurationFields.label: Maximum Packet Amount
configurationFields.description: The server will automatically kick players who are sending more than the set amount of network packets per minute. 1200 or less = disabled

configurationFields.label: Use Karma
configurationFields.description: If set, the [Karma system](https://barotraumagame.com/wiki/Karma) will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Karma Preset
configurationFields.description: Sets the karma rules preset that should be used. Requires Karma to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Install LuaCsForBarotrauma
configurationFields.description: If set, the [LuaCsForBarotrauma modification](https://evilfactory.github.io/LuaCsForBarotrauma/) will be installed when the server is updated, providing Lua and C# modding support. Update the server after changing this setting

deploymentSteps.name: Config Template Download
deploymentSteps.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<serversettings
  name="GSCS Barotrauma Server"
  port="27015"
  queryport="27016"
  password=""
  enableupnp="false"
  autorestart="false"
  LevelDifficulty="20"
  ServerMessage="Welcome to Barotrauma!"
  HiddenSubs=""
  AllowedRandomMissionTypes="Salvage,Monster,Cargo,Beacon,Nest,Mineral,Combat,AbandonedOutpost,Escort,Pirate,ScanAlienRuins,ClearAlienRuins,All"
  AllowedClientNameChars="32-33,38-46,48-57,65-90,91-91,93-93,95-122,192-255,384-591,1024-1279,4352-4607,44032-55215,19968-21327,21329-40959,13312-19903,131072-173791,173824-178207,178208-183983,63744-64255,194560-195103"
  IsPublic="False"
  TickRate="20"
  RandomizeSeed="True"
  UseRespawnShuttle="True"
  RespawnInterval="300"
  MaxTransportTime="180"
  MinRespawnRatio="0.2"
  SkillLossPercentageOnDeath="50"
  AutoRestartInterval="60"
  StartWhenClientsReady="False"
  StartWhenClientsReadyRatio="0.8"
  AllowSpectating="True"
  SaveServerLogs="True"
  AllowModDownloads="True"
  AllowFileTransfers="True"
  VoiceChatEnabled="True"
  PlayStyle="Casual"
  LosMode="Transparent"
  ShowEnemyHealthBars="ShowAll"
  LinesPerLogFile="800"
  AllowVoteKick="True"
  AllowEndVoting="True"
  AllowRespawn="True"
  BotCount="0"
  MaxBotCount="16"
  BotSpawnMode="Normal"
  DisableBotConversations="False"
  AllowDisguises="True"
  AllowRewiring="True"
  LockAllDefaultWires="False"
  AllowLinkingWifiToChat="False"
  AllowFriendlyFire="True"
  DestructibleOutposts="False"
  KillableNPCs="True"
  BanAfterWrongPassword="True"
  MaxPasswordRetriesBeforeBan="3"
  EnableDoSProtection="True"
  MaxPacketAmount="4000"
  SelectedSubmarine=""
  SelectedShuttle=""
  TraitorProbability="0"
  TraitorDangerLevel="1"
  TraitorsMinPlayerCount="1"
  MinPercentageOfPlayersForTraitorAccusation="50"
  Language="English"
  SubSelectionMode="Manual"
  ModeSelectionMode="Manual"
  EndVoteRequiredRatio="0.6"
  VoteRequiredRatio="0.6"
  VoteTimeout="30"
  KickVoteRequiredRatio="0.6"
  DisallowKickVoteTime="120"
  KillDisconnectedTime="300"
  KickAFKTime="600"
  KarmaEnabled="False"
  KarmaPreset="default"
  GameModeIdentifier="sandbox"
  MissionType="All"
  MaxPlayers="10"
  AutoBanTime="3600"
  MaxAutoBanTime="86400"
  LootedMoneyDestination="Bank"
  MaximumMoneyTransferRequest="999999">
  <campaignsettings
    PresetName="Normal"
    TutorialEnabled="True"
    RadiationEnabled="False"
    MaxMissionCount="2"
    StartingBalanceAmount="Medium"
    Difficulty="Medium"
    StartItemSet="normal" />
</serversettings>
